{{Quote|A flaky opee sea killer fillet expertly seasoned with Roonan lemon and black hole pepper, served with a sprig of celto and our own secret-recipe Iskalonian tartar sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, on its grilled opee|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''Roonan lemon''' was a variety of [[lemon]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roona/Legends|Roona]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|109|Roona}}</ref> and the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Starships & Vehicles 3">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|3|Star Wars A&ndash;Z}}</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], used Roonan lemon to season the grilled [[opee sea killer fillet]] it served. The diner also offered Roonan lemon [[stim tea]] as well as a Roonan lemon [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] flavoring for the [[fizzyglug]] drinks it sold.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roonan lemons were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
